title: Talliark WebView2 Message Protocol v1
description: Defines all messages exchanged between the C# host and the web apps over the WebView2 postMessage channel.

ViewerReadyMessage.description: Sent once by the document-viewer web app after JavaScript has initialised. The host responds by posting a PdfsLoadedMessage.

ViewerShellReadyMessage.description: Sent once by the document-viewer web app after its lightweight startup shell has mounted. The host may use this for diagnostics, but waits for ViewerContentReadyMessage before revealing the WebView.

ViewerContentReadyMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer web app after it has handled the initial PDF list and mounted the first visible content state. The host reveals the WebView after this message so startup transitions once from native placeholder to ready viewer.

ViewerSurfaceShownMessage.description: Sent by the C# host whenever an existing document-viewer surface is shown. The viewer must revalidate its page canvases without changing the active PDF, page, zoom, scroll position or overlays, because WebView2 may discard a hidden surface's painted canvas while JavaScript state still records it as rendered.

OpenFileManagerMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer web app when the user asks to open the workbook's Manage Files window.

PdfPayload.description: A single PDF document embedded in the workbook.

id.description: GUID that uniquely identifies this PDF within the workbook.

folderId.description: GUID of the owning folder, omitted when uncategorised.

financialStructureBase64.description: Optional gzip-compressed financial-structure-v1 JSON, base64-encoded. Present only for documents in the financial tier.

pageRotations.description: Optional map of 0-based page index to clockwise rotation in degrees (0, 90, 180, 270). Omitted entries default to 0.

PdfsLoadedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to push the current workbook's PDF list to the viewer. Re-sent after any add/remove operation. The folder list backs the viewer's folder filter; PDFs whose folderId is absent are uncategorised.

ViewerFoldersUpdatedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to the document-viewer whenever the folder catalogue or a PDF's folder assignment changes (folder added, renamed or deleted, or a file moved). Carries the full current folder list and the folder assignment of every PDF so the viewer can rebuild its folder filter without reloading PDF bytes.

assignments.description: One entry per PDF in the workbook.

folderId.description: GUID of the owning folder, omitted when uncategorised.

PdfUpdatedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when a single PDF's bytes change (e.g. after OCR). The viewer should update its entry list and reload the document if it is currently displayed.

PdfAddedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when a single new PDF is added to the workbook. The viewer should add the entry without reloading existing PDFs.

PdfNameUpdatedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when a PDF is renamed. The viewer should update the display name without reloading any PDF bytes.

PdfRemovedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when a PDF is deleted from the workbook. The viewer should remove the entry and revoke its blob URL.

ShowPdfMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to switch the document-viewer to a specific PDF without changing page, zoom or highlight state. Raised when the user selects a document in the file manager. The viewer should no-op when the PDF is already active, and ignore ids it does not know.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF to display.

ManagerReadyMessage.description: Sent once by the file-manager web app after JavaScript has initialised. The host responds by posting a FilesLoadedMessage.

FolderPayload.description: A named folder used to organise PDF documents.

id.description: GUID that uniquely identifies this folder.

FileMetadataPayload.description: Metadata for a single PDF in the file manager. Does NOT include base64 bytes.

id.description: GUID matching the storage Pdf id.

folderId.description: GUID of the owning folder, or omitted if uncategorised.

status.description: PDF content classification: ocr (processed), text (native text layer), none (scanned).

dateAdded.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the file was added.

FilesLoadedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to push the current workbook's file list to the file manager. Re-sent after any mutation.

AddFilePayload.description: A single file to be added, as sent from the web UI.

AddFilesMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user drops or picks files.

BrowsePdfFilesMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user asks to browse for PDFs. The C# host owns the native file picker and imports selected file paths.

RenameFileMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user renames a file.

RemoveFileMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user removes a file.

SelectFileMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user selects a single file in the list. The host forwards it to an open document-viewer as a ShowPdfMessage; it is dropped when no viewer surface is open. Not sent for multi-row (shift-click) selections or when a row is deselected.

id.description: GUID of the newly selected file.

MoveFileMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user moves a file to a different folder. Send folderId as null/omitted to move to uncategorised.

AddFolderMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user creates a new folder.

RenameFolderMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user renames a folder.

RemoveFolderMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user deletes a folder. Files in the folder become uncategorised.

SetSelectedFolderMessage.description: Sent when the user changes the active folder in the file manager. Used by the host when importing files from OS drag/drop (Explorer) so new PDFs match the current selection. Omit folderId when 'All Files' is selected.

folderId.description: GUID of the selected folder, absent for uncategorised / All Files.

RectPayload.description: A normalized rectangle (0–1 coordinate space, top-left origin) on a single PDF page.

TableGridPayload.description: Editable table grid inside a table link rectangle. Boundary positions are fractions of the rectangle width/height and exclude the fixed outer edges. Cells are supplied by the viewer on create/update for the Excel write and omitted when the host reloads persisted rectangles.

columnBoundaries.description: Sorted internal vertical boundary positions relative to the rectangle width.

rowBoundaries.description: Sorted internal horizontal boundary positions relative to the rectangle height.

cells.description: Row-major extracted cell text. Required by the host for table create/update operations.

TableGridWithCellsPayload.description: A table grid whose extracted row-major cell data is required.

LinkRectangleCreatedMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user finishes drawing a link rectangle. Contains the PDF region and the extracted, formatted text ready for cell insertion.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF the rectangle was drawn on.

text.description: Extracted and formatted text contained within the rectangle.

linkType.description: How the extracted text is processed before writing to Excel. Defaults to 'auto' if omitted.

appendToActiveSum.description: When true for a Sum link, append this rectangle's numbers to the currently active Sum-linked cell instead of creating a new link cell. Sent when the user holds Ctrl while completing the rectangle.

LinkRectangleUpdatedMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user finishes moving or resizing an existing link rectangle. Contains the updated PDF region and re-extracted text to replace the linked cell contents.

id.description: GUID of the LinkedRectangle being updated.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF the rectangle belongs to.

text.description: Re-extracted text contained within the updated rectangle.

CacheBuildStartedMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer immediately before building the per-page text-content cache for the loaded PDF. The host should show a loading indicator.

CacheBuildCompleteMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer once the text-content cache has been fully built. The host should hide the loading indicator.

LinkedRectanglePayload.description: A single persisted link rectangle, as sent from the C# host to the viewer.

id.description: GUID that uniquely identifies this linked rectangle.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF this rectangle belongs to.

linkType.description: How the linked text is processed before writing to Excel. Defaults to 'auto' if omitted.

LinkedRectanglesLoadedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to push the full set of persisted link rectangles to the viewer.

LinkedRectangleAddedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host after one link rectangle and its Excel data have been created. Allows multi-page Table copies to update the viewer incrementally without re-sending or re-rendering the complete rectangle collection.

LinkRectangleClickedMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user clicks a persisted link rectangle overlay. The host responds by activating the linked worksheet and selecting the linked cell.

id.description: GUID of the LinkedRectangle that was clicked.

LinkRectangleDeletedMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user removes a persisted link rectangle. The host always removes the link and its Excel tracking/style. When deleteCellData is true, the linked Excel data is removed (including a Table link's complete footprint); when false, existing values and formulas are preserved.

id.description: GUID of the LinkedRectangle to delete.

deleteCellData.description: True for a full delete; false to unlink while preserving the current Excel cell data.

TableSelectionCopyTargetPayload.description: Recalculated table grid and extracted data for one page that will receive a copy of the source Table rectangle. Column boundaries match the source selection; row boundaries are detected independently on the target page.

CopyTableSelectionMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer to copy one persisted Table rectangle to other pages. The host creates one link per target and stacks their Excel table footprints immediately below the source table in ascending page order.

id.description: GUID of the source Table LinkedRectangle.

ExcelNavigateMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user presses a cell-navigation key while the viewer has focus, so the keystroke drives the Excel grid instead of the WebView. The host owns all navigation semantics: Tab always moves horizontally, Enter follows Application.MoveAfterReturnDirection, an Enter that ends a Tab run returns to the column the run started in, and both motions cycle inside a multi-cell selection rather than collapsing it. The viewer deliberately sends no direction — it reports only which key was pressed.

motion.description: Which navigation key was pressed. 'tab' is always horizontal; 'enter' resolves against the user's Excel move-after-return setting.

reverse.description: True when Shift was held, reversing the motion (Shift+Tab, Shift+Enter).

UndoLinkCreationMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user presses Ctrl+Z (or Cmd+Z) while the viewer has focus. The host first delegates to Excel when its native Undo command has an available action. Only when Excel has nothing newer may the host pop the newest eligible entry from its in-memory per-workbook rectangle-creation stack, remove the rectangle, clear or rebuild the linked cell, and select that cell. If that newest entry is stale, undo stops instead of reaching backward to an older creation. Any persisted non-creation Talliark mutation disarms creation undo. Talliark undo covers rectangle creation only — edits, deletions and rotations are not undoable, and there is no redo.

LinkRectanglesRemovedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host after one or more link rectangles are deleted. The viewer should remove the matching overlay divs from the DOM (if present on the active PDF) without reloading all rectangles.

ids.description: GUIDs of the LinkedRectangles that were removed.

NavigateToRectangleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the user selects a linked cell in Excel. The viewer should switch to the specified PDF (if needed), jump instantly to the page, and highlight the rectangle.

id.description: GUID of the LinkedRectangle to highlight.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF containing the rectangle.

ClearRectangleHighlightMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the user selects a cell that is not linked to any rectangle. The viewer should remove any active rectangle highlight.

HighlightRectangleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to highlight a specific link rectangle in the viewer without changing zoom, scroll, or page. Used after a new rectangle is created so the overlay is visually selected.

id.description: GUID of the LinkedRectangle to highlight.

LinkSelectionEntryPayload.description: One linked rectangle contained in the current Excel selection. A Sum cell contributes one entry per contributing rectangle, all sharing the same cellAddress and cellValue.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF containing the rectangle.

pdfName.description: Display name of the PDF, shown only when the selection spans multiple documents.

value.description: Value attributable to this rectangle: for a Sum link the subtotal of the numbers it captured, formatted with the linked cell's number format; otherwise the displayed text of the linked cell. Falls back to the raw captured text when no numbers were found. Empty when unavailable.

valueCount.description: How many numbers this rectangle contributes to its Sum cell. 1 for a single value and for non-Sum links; greater than 1 when one rectangle captured several numbers, in which case the viewer shows the subtotal followed by this count rather than the individual items.

cellAddress.description: Sheet-qualified address of the linked cell, e.g. "Sheet1!B4". Entries sharing an address belong to the same cell.

cellValue.description: Displayed text of the linked Excel cell (Range.Text) — the computed total for a Sum cell. Identical across entries of the same cell.

LinkSelectionChangedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host on every Excel selection change while a viewer is open. Entries list every linked rectangle inside the selection, ordered by cell (top-to-bottom then left-to-right) and, within a Sum cell, by creation order. The host only populates entries when the selection contains at least two rectangles — which covers both several linked cells and a single Sum cell built from several rectangles. An empty list tells the viewer to hide the selection panel. Navigation and highlighting of the first selected rectangle continue to use navigate-to-rectangle.

SetSearchQueryMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the active Excel cell changes while a document-viewer is open. The viewer replaces its search-bar value with the cell's displayed text without running the full cross-document search or populating the results panel. It clears prior results and highlights indexed matches on every visible page of the currently selected PDF. Scrolling or changing documents refreshes that lightweight preview when the visible page set changes. An empty query clears the current search and preview highlights.

query.description: Displayed text (Range.Text) of the active cell. For a multi-cell selection, this is the active/anchor cell.

SetCharBboxesVisibleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the developer toggle in Settings → Development changes, and once after 'viewer-ready' so a newly opened viewer adopts the persisted state. The viewer shows or hides the per-character bounding-box debug overlay drawn from its text cache. Development/beta builds only.

visible.description: True draws the per-character bounding-box overlay on every rendered page; false clears it.

SetValuesVisibleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the detected-value overlay toggle changes and once after viewer-ready. Values measure, and their overlay is clickable.

SetReferencesVisibleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the reference overlay toggle changes and once after viewer-ready. References identify rather than measure -- an invoice number, an account number, a note citation -- and are click targets exactly as values are, on every document alike. Independent of the value layer so either can be drawn alone.

SetStructureVisibleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the structure overlay toggle changes and once after viewer-ready. Structure is the document indexing itself -- the number in a note heading, the ordinal opening a footnote. Nothing in it is a click target today, but that is each span's own `clickable` field to state; this flag decides only whether the boxes are drawn.

SetValueNoiseVisibleMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the development noise toggle changes and once after viewer-ready. Noise is the set of spans the detector recognized and then refused as neither value nor reference; the overlay it drives is inert and draws nothing clickable.

ResetUiMessage.description: Sent by the C# host when the file-manager window is hidden. The web app should reset transient UI state so the next show starts fresh.

CancelOcrMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user clicks 'Cancel OCR'. The host kills the worker process and reverts all queued/in-flight jobs to their original status (none or text).

OcrPdfsMessage.description: Sent by the file-manager web app when the user clicks 'OCR'. The host generates corrected OCR geometry for every selected PDF while retaining the source PDF as the viewer binary for visual fidelity, and replies with one or more OcrStatusMessages.

pdfIds.description: GUIDs of the PDFs to process.

RotatePageMessage.description: Sent by the document-viewer when the user clicks a rotate button. The host rotates the stored page rotation, transforms any link rectangles on that page, and responds with a PageRotationsUpdatedMessage followed by a LinkedRectanglesLoadedMessage.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF containing the page to rotate.

direction.description: Rotation direction: cw = 90° clockwise, ccw = 90° counter-clockwise.

PageRotationsUpdatedMessage.description: Sent by the C# host after a page is rotated. The viewer should update its rotation state and re-render the affected page.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF whose rotations changed.

rotations.description: Map of 0-based page index to new clockwise rotation in degrees.

ProgressStage.description: The step of the pipeline a progress message reports on. Mirrors ProgressStage in python-worker-v1.json, which is the source of the vocabulary — the two must be changed together. The enum is CLOSED and ORDERED: its order is the order the steps run in, which is what lets the file manager place a step on a progress bar. An adaptive run skips steps, so a consumer must tolerate gaps and must never assume the next message is the next member.

OcrStatusMessage.description: Sent by the C# host to the file-manager to report per-PDF OCR/Enhance progress. Transient values queued/processing/error are used during jobs; persisted status becomes ocr on success. Cancellation restores the prior persisted none or text status.

pdfId.description: GUID of the PDF being processed.

status.description: Job lifecycle state. ocr is sent when OCR or Enhance completes successfully; none or text restores the prior status after cancellation.

message.description: Optional human-readable detail for errors or the current processing stage. Presentation only — a consumer must not parse it for stage or counts, both of which are carried as their own fields.

current.description: Optional completed units within the active stage. Counts within the stage only, and resets when the stage changes — it is not progress through the file. Present only with total.

total.description: Optional total units within the active stage. When present with current, the file manager renders a determinate within-stage count. Present only with current.

unit.description: Optional. What current and total count. Present only with current and total.

fileIndex.description: Optional one-based position of this file in the run, so the pane can report run-level progress without parsing it out of a message.

fileCount.description: Optional number of files in the run. Present only with fileIndex.

ReconcileReadyMessage.description: Sent once by the reconcile web app after JavaScript has initialised. The host responds with ReconcileDataLoadedMessage. The app opens against the workbook, not against a sheet or a selection, so nothing about Excel's current state is carried here.

ReconcileStaleness.description: What the workbook holds for one document. 'none' means no scan has run -- the window must say so plainly rather than implying the document passed. 'stale' means a result exists but the detector versions or the geometry it was produced from no longer match what the workbook holds; it is shown labelled stale and is never silently recomputed, because a reviewer who has read a finding must not find it quietly changed underneath them. Only an explicit re-scan replaces a result.

ReconcileDocumentPayload.description: One document in the workbook as the Reconcile home lists it: what it is, and what reconcile data the workbook holds for it. The counts travel with the list so the home can render without loading a sum tree per document -- a clean scan reads '14 totals verified, 0 exceptions', which is what makes it trustworthy instead of indistinguishable from a scan that never ran.

folderId.description: GUID of the owning folder, absent when uncategorised.

scannedAt.description: When the stored scan completed, UTC. Presentation only -- staleness is decided by versions and geometry, never by age. Absent when staleness is none.

ReconcileSummaryPayload.description: The counts from a stored reconcile-v1 model's summary, copied verbatim. Every nominated total lands in exactly one of confirmed, breaks and unresolved.

ReconcileDataLoadedMessage.description: Sent by the host in response to ReconcileReadyMessage, and again whenever the workbook's documents or their stored results change. An empty documents array is what puts the app on its 'add or select a document' splash; a non-empty one puts it on the home.

scanning.description: GUID of the document a scan is already running for, so an app that mounts mid-scan shows progress rather than an idle home. Absent when no scan is running.

RunReconcileScanMessage.description: Sent by the reconcile web app to start a scan of one document. The host runs the existing ocr worker command with its analysis flag set, so the whole pipeline and the Reconcile engines are one sequential job under one cancellation. A scan is never started by the host on its own.

pdfId.description: GUID of the document to scan.

CancelReconcileScanMessage.description: Sent by the reconcile web app to cancel the running scan. Cancellation is handled exactly as OCR's is, and a cancelled scan leaves any previously stored result untouched.

ReconcileScanStatusMessage.description: Sent by the host to report scan progress for one document. The shape mirrors OcrStatusMessage deliberately: a scan is the OCR pipeline with two stages appended, and its progress is the same progress. stage is the machine-readable fact; message is prose beside it and must not be parsed.

pdfId.description: GUID of the document being scanned.

status.description: Job lifecycle state. complete is sent after the result is stored, and is followed by a ReconcileDataLoadedMessage carrying the new counts.

current.description: Completed units within the active stage. Counts within the stage only. Present only with total.

total.description: Total units within the active stage. Present only with current.

unit.description: What current and total count. Present only with current and total.

RequestReconcileResultMessage.description: Sent by the reconcile web app to load one document's stored sum tree. The list the home renders carries only counts, so the tree is fetched when a document is opened rather than with every list.

ReconcileResultLoadedMessage.description: Sent by the host in response to RequestReconcileResultMessage, carrying one document's whole reconcile-v1 model and the source PDF used by the review workspace. The model is gzip-compressed and base64-encoded, as table structure and document values are on the same channel; the PDF is its original base64 payload.

pdfBase64.description: Original PDF bytes, base64-encoded, so the reconcile workspace can keep the evidence beside its findings. Absent only when the document no longer exists.

pageRotations.description: Optional map of 0-based page index to the workbook's stored clockwise rotation in degrees, so the evidence view stays aligned with the scan geometry.

reconcileBase64.description: Gzip-compressed reconcile-v1 JSON, base64-encoded. Absent when the workbook holds no result for this document.

LinkerAppReadyMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app once mounted. The host responds with LinkerReadyMessage.

LinkerKeyColumnPayload.description: A selected Excel key column range used for document matching.

LinkerOutputColumnPayload.description: An Excel output column available to receive created links.

LinkerReadyMessage.description: Sent by C# host in response to linker-app-ready. Contains Excel selection metadata and available folders.

LinkerSelectionLockedMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app when the user leaves Step 1. The host freezes the current Excel selection for matching.

LinkerSelectionUnlockedMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app when the user returns to Step 1. The host resumes live Excel selection updates.

LinkerPreviewOutputRangeMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app while the user hovers (or keyboard-focuses) an option in an output column dropdown on Step 2. The host selects the range that would receive links for that column — the key selection's row span in the given column — so the user can see where output lands. The host remembers the pre-preview selection and restores it on linker-clear-output-range-preview.

colNumber.description: 1-based Excel column number of the hovered output column.

LinkerClearOutputRangePreviewMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app when hover preview ends — the dropdown closed, the pointer left the option list, or the wizard left Step 2. The host restores the Excel selection captured before the first linker-preview-output-range. Safe to send when no preview is active.

LinkerLogMessage.description: Diagnostic message sent by the document-linker web app for host-side logging.

LinkerGeometryPreparedMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app after preparing transient text geometry from a text-layer PDF. The host caches this geometry in memory for the workbook session only.

geometryBase64.description: Gzip-compressed text-geometry-v1 JSON, base64-encoded. Not persisted to workbook storage.

LinkerSelectionChangedMessage.description: Sent by C# host when the Excel selection changes while the linker wizard is open.

StartMatchingMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app when the user clicks Start. The host responds with LinkerDataLoadedMessage.

folderIds.description: Folder ids to search. The reserved value __all__, or an empty array, means search every PDF in the workbook.

LinkerDataLoadedMessage.description: Sent by C# host with key column values per data row and PDF geometry for matching.

keyValues.description: Semantic Excel cell values used for matching. Date-formatted cells are rendered with their Excel number format instead of being sent as OA serial numbers.

geometryBase64.description: Stored OCR/Enhance geometry or transient session-cached geometry.

base64.description: PDF bytes as base64, present only when geometryBase64 is unavailable and the web linker must prepare transient text-layer geometry.

CreateLinksMessage.description: Sent by the document-linker web app after matching is complete. C# creates the links and responds with LinksCreatedMessage.

LinksCreatedMessage.description: Sent by C# host after all link creation requests have been processed.
